operation_scope.reason: ADM2687E limit and Nexperia 85 C parameter column; this is not a full-system temperature rating.
operation_scope.ESP32_N16R8_temperature_note: Module N16R8 is specified to 65 C with default octal PSRAM operation; the documented ECC option permits 85 C with reduced usable PSRAM. Firmware, enclosure and all other components require a separate system limit.
operation_scope.local_rail_scope: Conservative addition of full 0..100% load specs at 25 C. Temperature coefficient, PCB drops, ripple and dynamic excursions excluded; not a guaranteed full-temperature envelope.
operation_scope.temperature_coefficient_note: Adding 65 K times stated 0.01%/K is illustrative: coefficient is not identified as a guaranteed maximum.
